name: rejoinbi
description: Validate Rejoin BI manifests, upload paths and release readiness through its public read-only service.

interface.longDescription: Rejoin BI provides an anonymous, read-only release validator. It checks rejoinbi-app.json manifests and upload paths, explains full versus changed-files deployment choices, maps common errors to safe next steps, and returns release-readiness checklists. This public directory edition does not sign in to customer workspaces, list workspace data, upload files, publish dashboards, manage databases, or change platform state. The full desktop CLI is distributed separately.
defaultPrompt: Check these paths before I upload a project
